story.fullStory:
Calloway's "I Wanna Be Rich" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I Wanna Be Rich" is a song by American R&B duo Calloway.

It was released in October 1989 as the third and final single from their debut album, All the Way (1989).

It is the band's only top-10 hit on the US Billboard Hot 100, reaching number two in May 1990, and it also peaked at number five on the Billboard Hot Black Singles chart.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.
